title: Jaw Dropping Spanish Shrimp Gambas Al Ajillo
description: Savory and indulgent Spanish dish featuring shrimp in a spicy coconut cream sauce, this recipe is a twist on the classic gambas al ajillo with a Cajun kick.
instructions: Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2 minutes per side until pink and cooked through.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
Add the coconut cream, cajun seasoning, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper to the skillet.
Stir the sauce until it is smooth and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 2 minutes until it has thickened slightly.
Return the shrimp to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
Sprinkle the parsley over the top and serve immediately.
